decisions.statement: A seat hangs under the seat that seat names as its parent.
A seat answering to Alan is a root however that seat names its parent.
A seat naming a parent no row answers to is a root.
A seat naming itself as its parent is a root.
A seat already on the descent is not hung beneath itself again.
A branch with nothing running is dropped whole.
A seat naming no name is drawn under its id.
A seat whose place no row states is headless.
Seats are ordered by name and the subagents follow those seats.
A subagent is keyed by the seat that ran that subagent at whatever depth that subagent sits.
A subagent naming no id that subagent runs under names no page.
A subagent is drawn as running and coloured for the working turn.
A subagent the pages name as stopped is drawn as stopped.
A path is joined against the repository the answer named rather than a repository guessed here.
A seat name and an id are parted by a byte neither name nor id can have.
Nothing here asks the harness anything.

definition: the seats and the subagents under them hung into the tree the panel draws
